summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a 424B5 pricing supplement covering the issuance of $500K in Senior Autocallable Barrier Notes due 2031 linked to the worst-performing of the Nasdaq-100, Russell 2000, and EURO STOXX 50 indices. The notes are senior unsecured obligations under its Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program, issued at $1,000 per note, with a semi-annual autocall feature and a call premium of ~14.25% per annum. Payment at maturity depends on index performance, with principal at risk if the worst-performing underlying falls below its threshold. This is a routine structured note offer, not a special situation.
